summary: Mountain Hill (Haskell Hill), Lincoln County, Maine: 47-foot steel lookout from fall 1931; bought and moved to private property in 2007, re-erection on Lasell Island reported.

facts.design: 47-foot steel lookout tower, part of a 1931 program of new steel lookouts
facts.status_note: Removed from its Jefferson hill in 2007; the 2007 report says the buyer was re-erecting it on Lasell Island, and the Maine list records the site as gone

access.note: Moved to private property in 2007 after a private party bought it; no public access is described in the sources read

events.note: A new lookout erected on Mountain Hill in Lincoln County in 1931; the state decided on the program in the fall of 1931
Bought by a private party, dismantled by Rockport Steel, barged to Lasell Island; the 2007 report says re-erection was under way

evidence.supports: the fall 1931 program for districts without a lookout tower
evidence.quote: In the Fall of 1931 it was decided to do away with the handicap of certain districts not having a lookout tower

evidence.supports: five new 47-foot steel lookout stations, one dismantled, erected in 1931
evidence.quote: five new forty-seven foot steel lookout stations and one dismantled one were erected on peaks in the Organized Towns

evidence.supports: a new lookout erected on Mountain Hill in Lincoln County
evidence.quote: A new lookout was erected on Mountain Hill in Lincoln County.

evidence.supports: lookout moved in July 2007 to a site on private property
evidence.quote: July 2007: The lookout removed to a site on private property.

evidence.supports: the Maine Forest Service is the agency
tower lost from Jefferson after a private party bought it
evidence.quote: We lost Haskell Hill in Jefferson as a private party purchased it

evidence.supports: buyer hired Rockport Steel to remove the tower
evidence.quote: hired Rockport Steel to remove it

evidence.supports: tower barged to Lasell Island where the buyer is re-erecting it
evidence.quote: barged it to Lasell Island where he is re-erecting it

evidence.supports: Maine list records the Haskell Hill site as Tower Gone
the 1931 report is the state's annual report
evidence.quote: Annual Report of the Forest Commissioner of the State of Maine

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1931 report and Forest Lookouts call it Mountain Hill (Haskell Hill); the 2007 report and the Maine list call it Haskell Hill, in Jefferson. The Forest Lookouts page treats them as one tower, and the story uses both names.

notes_for_editor: Only three sources, all read. Staffing is not covered by any source read; a Facebook caption seen only in search results (not fetched, not cited) says a Levi Walton manned the tower from about 1975 to 1991, so staffing could be added if that caption is verified. Current state of the Lasell Island tower is unknown. The 1931 program quote covers five 47-foot towers; the source links the Mountain Hill lookout to that program, and the 47-foot size rests on the 1935 newspaper item. No photos added.
